description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'ScopeRepositoryTest' that tests the 'ScopeRepository' class in the OAuth module of OrangeHRM. It includes test methods for retrieving scope entities by identifier and finalizing scopes, giving insight into OAuth scope handling within the repository layer.

classes.name: ScopeRepositoryTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing 'ScopeRepository' methods within the OAuth repository of OrangeHRM.

methods.name: testGetScopeEntityByIdentifier
methods.description: Tests that 'getScopeEntityByIdentifier' returns null when querying an unrecognized scope.

methods.name: testFinalizeScopes
methods.description: Tests that 'finalizeScopes' returns an empty array when called with specific parameters, verifying scope finalization behavior.
